name: Robinsons Manila
summary: A reference-based mall reconstruction with connected wings, atriums, and the curved Midtown frontage.
layoutNote: Building envelope uses OpenStreetMap geometry. Interior circulation and shop divisions are manually interpreted from the supplied map; its floor is not confirmed. Upper levels, doorway positions, heights, vertical connections, and tenant coordinates are estimates. Selected tenant levels follow the official directory. Exterior details reference May 2025 photographs. Surrounding residential towers are omitted to keep the model focused and lightweight. No surveyed accuracy percentage or approved evacuation route is claimed. Kenney CC0 furnishings are illustrative.

name: Estancia · Main Mall GF
summary: Individual store outlines from the official directory, with modeled partitions.
layoutNote: Main Mall ground floor only. Store polygons and facility markers follow the official Ortigas Malls directory snapshot of 9 October 2026. Cutaway walls follow its click areas; doorway gaps, heights, floor outline, and metric scale are estimates. Counters, seating, and escalator details are illustrative artwork. Two conflicting store-floor labels are excluded from destinations. No measured accuracy percentage or approved evacuation route is claimed. Interior props are reused from Kenney CC0 kits and arranged by store type; actual tenant furnishings and merchandise are not verified.
